$schema.description: The schema this file is written against, for editors.

code.description: The plugin's short code: 2 to 40 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

description.description: One sentence on what the plugin does.

requires.description: What the plugin needs to run.

teme.description: The Teme versions it works with, as a Composer constraint.

plugins.description: Other plugins it needs enabled, by Composer name, each with the versions it works with as a Composer constraint.

plugin.description: The class that implements the Plugin contract.

capabilities.description: What the plugin asks to be allowed to do.

jobs.description: Background jobs the plugin declares; each needs the jobs capability and a handler the plugin class answers for its key.

key.description: The job's key, which the plugin queues it by: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter, at most 48 characters.

label.description: The name people see for its runs, up to 80 characters.

long.description: Whether a run may take long: up to 30 minutes, on the long queue, with 5 minutes for each outbound call, instead of 75 seconds and 10.

tries.description: How many times a run is tried before it is marked failed: 1 to 5, 3 by default.

backoff.description: The seconds to wait before each new try, 1 to 3,600 each; 30, 120 and 600 by default.

schedules.description: How often a declared job runs, counted from its last queued run.

job.description: The key of a job the plugin declares under jobs.

enabledBy.description: One of the plugin's boolean settings, which switches the schedule on and off.

everyFrom.description: One of the plugin's select settings whose options are all intervals above; how often the schedule runs, every when unset.

routes.description: Public addresses the plugin answers when granted routes.public.

id.description: The route's id, unique in the plugin: lower-case letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

method.description: The one method it answers; a GET also answers HEAD.

path.description: The address it answers, starting with a slash; {code} stands for the plugin's code and {name} for one segment. Without a condition it must sit under /{code}/ or /.well-known/.

handler.description: The class that answers it, implementing the PublicRoute contract, built with no constructor arguments.

when.description: A condition a request must meet, which lets the path sit outside the plugin's own: query parameters, Accept types, or both.

query.description: Query parameters the request must carry, each with a regular expression its value must match.

accept.description: Media types, one of which the request's Accept header must name.

verify.description: How a POST proves it is genuine; every POST route needs one.

kind.description: secret compares a value the request carries with the secret setting; hmac checks a header holding the body's SHA-256 HMAC under that secret; custom asks the class named in class.

secret.description: The key of one of the plugin's own settings of type secret; needed for secret and hmac, optional for custom, whose class is given an empty secret without it.

from.description: For secret: where the request carries the value, as header:, field: or query: and a name.

header.description: For hmac: the header that holds the signature.

class.description: For custom: the class that checks the request, implementing the InboundVerifier contract, built with no constructor arguments and given the secret's value, or an empty string when secret is left out.

cache.description: For a GET: lets the page cache keep its answer. The key must carry everything the condition reads.

lifetime.description: The most seconds a shared cache in front of the site may keep the answer: it is told this, at most 60, and 60 when it is left out.

query.description: The query parameters the cached answer varies by; every query parameter in the condition must be named.

varyAccept.description: Whether the cached answer varies by Accept type; needed when the condition reads Accept.

maxBody.description: For a POST: the largest body it accepts, in bytes; 1 MB by default, held between 1 byte and 10 MB. A larger one is refused before it is read.

throttle.description: Requests a minute it answers from one address: 120 for a GET and 30 for a POST by default, held between 1 and 240 for a GET, 60 for a POST.

where.description: For each {name} in the path, a regular expression its segment must match; one segment of anything but a slash by default.

rootFiles.description: Plain-text files at the site's root that core serves for the plugin when it is granted routes.public, such as a verification key: at most 2, each never stored and never indexed.

id.description: The file's id, once per plugin.

name.description: The file's name: 8 to 128 letters, digits and hyphens, then .txt, or {key}.txt to take it from one of the plugin's own text settings.

body.description: What the file says: at most 1,024 bytes, or {key} to take it from one of the plugin's own text settings.

imports.description: What the plugin brings across from the WordPress site an import reads, when granted import.wordpress.

hosts.description: The hosts the plugin asks to reach, when it asks for http.

hostsFrom.description: Up to 3 of the plugin's own url or urls settings whose hosts it may reach once a person agrees, at enable or when saving the setting. Needs http.

hooks.description: The hooks the plugin listens to, by name: a Teme hook's, or another plugin's as code:Name.

contributes.description: What the plugin adds to the admin.

fixedLabel.description: The label core draws on the plugin's fixed insertions; Advertisement when absent.

default.description: The value before anyone changes it; any JSON value.

options.description: For a select: value to label.

min.description: The least a number may be.

max.description: The most a number may be.

maxLength.description: The longest a text may be.

required.description: Whether the setting must be filled in.

example.description: An example value shown as a hint.

unit.description: The unit shown beside a number.

taxonomy.description: For a term: the taxonomy its terms come from.

multiple.description: For a term: whether several may be chosen.

section.description: The id of the settingsSections entry the setting sits in.

visibleWhen.description: Shows the setting only while every earlier setting named has this value, or one of a list of values.

fields.description: A repeater's fields, one item's worth: scalar types and code.

itemLabel.description: What one of a repeater's items is called, as its Add button names it.

itemTitle.description: The key of the field whose value titles a collapsed item.

scripts.description: A code setting whose inline scripts wait for an administrator's approval.

admin.description: Entries the plugin adds to the admin.

to.description: Where it leads: the plugin's settings, or an https address.

columns.description: Columns the plugin adds to the content lists.

label.description: The heading and the name in Columns.

types.description: Content type keys; absent means every listed type.

feedLinks.description: Links core writes in every feed, after its own rel="self". Needs feeds.links.

href.description: An https:// address, or {key} naming one of the plugin's own url or urls settings (a urls setting gives a link for each address, at most 5).

actions.description: Buttons on the plugin's settings page, each queuing one of its declared jobs. Needs jobs.

description.description: What the action does, beside the button.

job.description: The key of the declared job it queues.

lists.description: Small tables on the plugin's settings page.

rows.description: The most rows it shows; 20 when absent.

csp.description: The hosts the content the plugin inserts loads from, by kind. Read only for a plugin granted content.insert or pages.insert, listed in the consent, and added to a page's policy only where that plugin's insertions were drawn.

aiTasks.description: The AI tasks the plugin asks the site's AI connection for, through SiteAi. Needs the ai capability.

id.description: The task's id, as SiteAi::ask() names it.

label.description: The task's name in the consent and on Settings › AI.

needs.description: What a model must be able to do for this task.

sends.description: What it sends: only what the plugin writes itself, published text, or an item's unpublished text.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens one answer may hold.

editorPanels.description: Panels in the editor's rail for the item being edited: each shows a status line, the plugin's work on the item and the changes it suggests. Needs content.read and jobs.

id.description: The panel's id; its tool in the editor is plugin.{code}.{id}.

label.description: The panel's name in the editor's Tools and at the head of its pane.

description.description: One line at the top of the panel.

types.description: The content types whose editor shows the panel.

permission.description: One of the plugin's permissions, which a person must hold to see the panel.

actions.description: What the panel can be asked to do: each queues one of the plugin's jobs on the item, as the person.

id.description: The action's id, in the job's payload.

job.description: The key of the declared job it queues.

confirm.description: A sentence the person confirms before the job is queued.

fields.description: A small form whose values go to the job.

key.description: The value's key in the job's payload.

required.description: Whether the person must fill it.

maxLength.description: For text, up to 500; for textarea, up to 2,000.

options.description: A select's values and their labels.

editorChecks.description: Checks core asks the plugin to run on the item being edited, drawn beside the editor's own under the plugin's name. Needs content.read.

id.description: The check's id, which each result names.

label.description: The check's name in the editor, unless a result gives its own.

types.description: The content types whose editor runs the check.

searchSection.description: The plugin's own tab in the editor's Search and social box: fields saved with each item's revision, under the plugin's key.

description.description: One line at the top of the tab.

types.description: The content types whose box shows the tab.

position.description: Where the tab sits among core's; last when absent.

key.description: The value's key under the plugin's own.

maxLength.description: The longest text a text or textarea field takes; 200 and 2,000 when absent.

options.description: A select field's options, each value and its label.

summary.description: Whether the field's value shows in the tab's one-line summary; the first field's does when none says.

sitemaps.description: Sitemaps the plugin adds to the site's sitemap index, each at sitemap-plugin-{code}-{id}.xml. Needs sitemaps.

id.description: The sitemap's id, in its address.

label.description: What it lists, as the consent names it.

structuredData.description: The schema.org terms the plugin's graph nodes use beyond the graph's own list. Needs pages.head.

notices.description: Kinds of notice the plugin sends through Notices, with notices.send; never required.

label.description: The choice as Account › Notifications words it.

audience.description: Who may receive it: starter, only the person the plugin's work acts for; plugins.manage, those who manage plugins; or the id of a permission the plugin declares, its holders.

defaults.description: The channels on until the person chooses; some of its channels.

hooks.description: Hooks the plugin declares for other plugins, which it sends through HookSender.

name.description: Its name; other plugins list it as code:Name.

class.description: Its class, in the plugin's own namespace: a Notification, Transform or Collect hook with #[HookContract].

description.description: What it is for, in one sentence.

settingsSections.description: The sections the plugin's settings page is split into, in order.

id.description: The section's id, which a setting's section names.

permissions.description: Permissions the plugin declares, named plugin.{code}.{id}; administrators always hold them.

label.description: What it lets a person do.

roles.description: The roles given it when it is first made.

area.description: The plugin's own area in the admin: pages of blocks core draws, and records' forms.

label.description: The area's word for what it holds, used inside it.

permission.description: The id of the declared permission that opens the area.

purges.description: What core purges after a write that changed something.

pages.description: The area's pages, each its id, label and blocks.

records.description: The kinds of record the area's tables list and its forms edit.

owns.description: Tables this plugin creates. Each name starts with the plugin’s code as a prefix (hyphens become underscores).

tables.description: Table names the plugin’s migrations create: lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with the prefix, at most 63 characters.

icon.description: The plugin’s icon: a path inside the plugin, with no .., to a .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp or .svg picture, in any case. Square; drawn at up to 96 pixels. A missing file is no error.

screenshots.description: Up to 8 pictures of the plugin at work, in the order Teme’s directory shows them.

path.description: A path inside the plugin, with no .., to a .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp picture, in any case.

caption.description: What the picture shows, in at most 140 characters.

license.description: The license it is released under.
